results.title: Chathuranga visits Custom Denning facilities in Sydney
results.description: Industry and Entrepreneurship Development Deputy Minister Chathuranga Abeysinghe, conducted an official visit to Custom Denning’s electric bus manufacturing facility in St Marys, Sydney, on 17 August 2026.
